rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.0025, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.02, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-10 STEP-SIZE probe (revert optimizer). iter-9 tv_optimizer gd->adam COLLAPSED hr 0.36286->0.0 (adam lr=0.01 destabilized the data term) => GD is required; revert to gd. Earlier GD logs show the TV term still descending at iter-1000 (under-converged). ONE knob: tv_lr 0.01->0.02 (2x GD step; keep gd, lambda=2.5e-3, 1000 iters, decay=0.01, fbp). HYPOTHESIS: a larger GD step lets the TV objective descend further within 1000 iters so hr rises past 0.36286; if it destabilizes the data term (hr drops) then lr=0.01 was near the GD stability limit and I revert + add iterations instead. Budget: ~950s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
